title: Local freeness detected by the Fitting ideal of a presentation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma relates the Fitting ideal of a presentation of a finite module to the locus where the module is locally free of a given rank, and its proof is a 43-line argument. It chooses a presentation, identifies the Fitting ideal as the ideal generated by the maximal minors of the presentation matrix, and then proves the two implications by localising: on the one hand a rank condition forces a minor to become a unit, on the other the invertibility of a minor exhibits the localised module as a free module of the expected rank. The two directions are carried out with explicit matrices, so the proof is a computation rather than a citation.
